$comment: The Partner Strip: one entry per institution (Argonne, which leads IDEAS, then the Partners), in strip order. Reorder, add or remove entries here and run `npm test`. Each file is official artwork in assets/partners/raw/, embedded byte-for-byte: never recoloured. Clear space ratios are fractions of the logo's ink height (the artwork trimmed to its visible edges). Minimum sizes are each institution's own rules. See assets/partners/raw/SOURCES.md for the full records.

clearSpace.basis: No published rule obtained (anl.gov blocks automated access). IDEAS default: a quarter of the logo height.

rules.coBranding: Not retrieved. Argonne leads IDEAS and is placed first.

clearSpace.basis: A square equal to the height from the baseline to the top of the initial "U" (measured: 0.97 of the wordmark height).

minimum.basis: The standard wordmark must be at least 1 inch wide for all uses.

rules.coBranding: Never add names or graphic elements to the wordmark or use it as part of a larger mark. Keep it prominent and readable.

clearSpace.basis: The height of the letter "C" (measured: 0.21 of the primary logo height).

minimum.basis: Primary logo: at least 80 px wide on screen, 0.75 in in print.

rules.coBranding: UC requires co-brands to be made by UC Marketing + Communications with UC leftmost. Waived for the Partner Strip by Cincinnati (#7).

clearSpace.basis: The height of "UIC" in the circle mark (measured: 0.32 of the logo height).

rules.coBranding: Permitted; order follows the hosting brand, so Argonne first satisfies it.

clearSpace.basis: One inside-serif height of the red N (measured: 0.25 of the N height).

rules.coBranding: No co-branding rules published. The N must appear; the horizontal N | NEBRASKA lockup is used because it reads at strip height.

clearSpace.basis: No published rule. IDEAS default: a quarter of the logo height.

rules.coBranding: Trademarked; Kitware granted IDEAS permission to use it (#7).

clearSpace.basis: No published rule. IDEAS default: a quarter of the logo height.

rules.coBranding: No brand page or usage rules published. Veeda publishes its logotype only as an animation; the strip uses frame 340, the frame veeda.ai itself shows as the static logo for reduced-motion visitors.

strip.$comment: Logos are sized for equal visual weight: a logo of ink aspect ratio a gets height s / a^opticalWeight (0 = equal heights, 0.5 = equal areas). Neighbours are at least `gap` × s apart, and never closer than either one's clear space. Sizes are for the 16:9 Slide Template (13.333 × 7.5 in).

large.use: Title and Closing slides, on the white band across the bottom. The end logos carry their clear space, so about 0.5 in shows at each slide edge
